correctness.rationale: The infinite-strip deck action gives squared distance D_M^2=min(t^2+(y1-y2)^2,(a-t)^2+(y1+y2)^2); the matched cylinder uses min(t,a-t)^2+(y1-y2)^2. For independent uniform y_i∈[-b,b], the absolute sum/difference (S,V) have constant density 1/(2b^2) on S,V>=0,S+V<=2b; hence P(S<=u or V<=v)=L_b(u+v) and P(S<=z)=L_b(z). The independent horizontal difference has density 2(a-t)/a^2. Integration yields the claimed two CDFs, whose integrands satisfy L_b(u+v)>=L_b(max(u,v)). For 0<=r<=a/2, supports of u,v do not overlap. For a/2<r<R_C, around t=a/2 both u,v>0 and max(u,v)<2b, so a positive-measure strict gap exists. For r>=R_C=sqrt(a^2/4+4b^2), max(u,v)>=2b throughout. At r=a/2+epsilon, only |t-a/2|<epsilon contributes; min(u,v)=sqrt(a epsilon)sqrt(1-|s|)+O(epsilon^(3/2)), L_b(u+v)-L_b(max)=min(u,v)/b+O(epsilon). Integrating with weight 1/a and ∫[-1,1]sqrt(1-|s|)ds=4/3 gives 4/(3b sqrt(a))epsilon^(3/2)+O(epsilon^2). Compact support and the strict CDF gap imply strict positive-moment inequality. Independently reconstructed the complete seven-blob canonical Git tree and its source-tree SHA; a separate SciPy quadrature at (a,b)=(1,.35),(2,.4),(3,2) checked equality/strictness and onset ratios approaching one as epsilon decreased 1e-3 to 1e-5. Numeric checks are not used as infinite proofs.
residual_risks: The bounds and onset expansion hold pointwise for each fixed a,b>0, not uniformly when dimensions degenerate; no such uniformity is asserted.
Quadrature and numerical sample verification cover finitely many positive dimensions and do not establish the universal statements alone.
